close_reason: serde_json::from_value(Value::String(s)) is idiomatic for MailboxRole deserialization; no FromStr impl exists on MailboxRole.
description: mailbox.rs build_mailbox_from_props (line ~992): to parse a role string s into MailboxRole, constructs Value::String(s.to_owned()) and calls serde_json::from_value on it. This allocates a String just to wrap s in a JSON value to feed to serde. If MailboxRole derives Deserialize from string, the canonical approach is serde_json::from_str(&format\!('"{}"', s)) or implementing FromStr on MailboxRole, or using serde_json::from_value(Value::String(s)) where s is already a String. The s.to_owned() here is the extra allocation — s is &str from a map key, so Value::String(s.to_owned()) is correct but the wrapping is inelegant; a FromStr or a direct variant lookup would avoid the double step.
title: build_mailbox_from_props uses serde to parse MailboxRole from a Value::String it constructs
